prompt:
A sprite sheet of 12 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 4 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) stone stairs going up: a short flight of steps rising toward the top of the image; 2) stairs going down: a square opening in the floor with stone steps descending into darkness; 3) heavy wooden door set in a stone arch frame, closed, seen front-on; 4) iron wall lever pointing up (off); 5) the SAME lever pulled down (on); 6) wooden ladder leaning upright; 7) short section of rope-and-plank bridge seen from above; 8) small round spring pool with a mossy stone rim and clear turquoise water (about 2 x 2 map tiles); 9) cluster of glowing pale-blue crystals growing from rock; 10) tall carved standing stone with a spiral rune (a singing stone); 11) cluster of small glowing teal mushrooms; 12) large iron beacon brazier for the top of a lighthouse (unlit).
Scale: the stairs are about 32 art pixels wide, the door about 24 wide and 34 tall, the spring pool about 60 wide, the singing stone about 44 tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: crystals, mushrooms and the spring water may be softly luminous in colour, but no light spills around them.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Generate a single transparent-background sprite sheet of EXACTLY 12 independent top-down 3/4-view JRPG environment prop sprites, laid out in 3 columns x 4 rows, reading order, with generous transparent spacing, nothing cropped or touching. Row 1: (1) short stone staircase rising away toward image top, visible step treads and front risers; (2) distinct descending stairs inside a square floor opening, descending into a dark recess; (3) closed heavy wood door front-facing within stone arch. Row 2: (4) wall-mounted iron lever handle pointing UP, off; (5) identical wall-mounted iron lever with handle pulled DOWN, on; (6) upright leaning wood ladder. Row 3: (7) short rope-and-plank bridge section from above; (8) small ROUND turquoise spring pool with moss-covered stone rim, wider than other objects, approximately 2x2 map tiles; (9) pale blue crystalline cluster emerging from rocks. Row 4: (10) tall carved standing stone bearing ONE prominent spiral rune; (11) small cluster of teal mushrooms; (12) LARGE unlit iron lighthouse beacon brazier, no flame. Classic top-down three-quarter game sprites: show top surfaces and front faces; objects stand vertically with base at bottom. Crisp premium hand-placed HD pixel art, uniform square pixel grid across every sprite, sharp hard pixel edges, discrete colored blocks and tasteful pixel clusters, no smooth strokes, no antialiasing, no gradients, no noise or dithering. Rich earthy hue-shifted 4-6-color ramps per material, warm yellow-tinged highlights, muted purple-red saturated shadows; even soft neutral illumination from upper-left. Crystals, mushroom caps and turquoise water have luminous COLOR only, NO emitted glow or halos. No cast shadows, ground plane, drop shadows, light pools, text, labels, numbering, borders, sheet guides or extra props. Fully transparent alpha background.
